meaning: Heat pump motor circuit fault at the main control board.
causes: Heat pump motor circuit fault at the main control board
diySteps: Reset power at the breaker for 30 seconds, then turn it back on
If E01 is still there, call Bosch Customer Support at 1-800-944-2904 with the model number
proAdvice: Bosch's only steps for E01 are the 30-second breaker reset and Customer Support. It is not E12, which is limescale and is descaled. It is not E09 or E20, which Bosch calls an internal heater fault.
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
